title: Scatterplot with Optional Line of Best Fit
description: A cloud of data points in the xy-plane with an optional line of best fit. Serves Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (two-variable-data): association strength/direction, predicting from the line of best fit, and interpreting slope in context.

points.description: Data points. Renderer jitters coincident pairs apart by one half-cell so no two dots fully overlap.

gridExtent.description: Axis maxima; must cover all points with at least one cell of headroom (renderer validates).

lineOfBestFit.description: Null for association-only questions; otherwise the line the stem references (same m, b).

show.description: Draw the line; false lets the stem ask students to sketch/estimate it.

notes: Renderer guarantees: first-quadrant axes with equal unit spacing; every point validated inside gridExtent; if lineOfBestFit.show is true the line is clipped to the axes and its slope/intercept match the spec exactly — the stem's predicted values are computed from the same m and b.
